intended_object: Suppose the actions of M and N on α commute. Then for each c : M, the map x ↦ c • x is N-equivariant, so it is a homomorphism of N-actions α → α. This comes from the docstring.
explanation: The underlying function is `(c • ·)`. Equivariance under N is `c • (n • x) = n • (c • x)`, and `smul_comm` gives exactly this. The result has the type `α →[N] α`, which is `MulActionHom id`, the type of N-equivariant maps. The setting is already as general as it can be. The definition needs only bare `SMul` instances and `SMulCommClass`, with no monoid or action axioms, so nothing could be weakened. The additive version is generated by `to_additive`. Mathlib has related constructions, such as `DistribMulAction.toLinearMap`, but they carry more structure. No other Mathlib declaration produces this plain action homomorphism, so no counterpart is listed.
